title: Level 1 (Beginner) - A-17
notes:
South has 8 top tricks available (3 spades, 3 hearts, and 2 clubs). Despite having no diamond higher than the ♦9, the diamond suit is South's only hope of scoring a ninth trick.

This can be accomplished if the defensive diamonds divide 3-2. South should lead diamonds at every opportunity. If South cashes tricks in the other suits he may make it possible for the defenders to cash 5 tricks before South can take 9 tricks.
